source_findings.subject: Owning ProducedInvocation<'p> encapsulation and single-call guarantee
source_findings.detail: ProducedInvocation<'p> holds private fields (program: &'p StagedProgram, input: CapturedInvocationInput, result: Result<StageOutcome, StageRejection>), and CapturedInvocationInput is a private enum. Only start_observed and resume_observed can construct ProducedInvocation<'p>. start_observed invokes crate::stage::start(program, &action, scenario.clone(), cap) exactly once and retains the owned action, unmutated Scenario clone, cap, and raw Result. resume_observed invokes crate::stage::resume(program, continuation.clone(), event.clone(), cli_action.as_deref(), cli_cap) exactly once and retains the owned Continuation, StageEvent, cli_action: Option<String>, cli_cap: Option<UInt>, and raw Result. Neither raw_result(), observation(), nor publication() invokes stage::start, stage::resume, parser, policy, or runtime evaluator.

source_findings.subject: Exhaustive borrowed field projection, lifetimes, and Serialize implementations
source_findings.detail: ExecutionObservation<'a>, SegmentObservation<'a>, FinancialObservation<'a>, ResumeFinancialObservation<'a>, InvocationInput<'a>, AccountFlow<'a>, AccountingReport<'a>, AccountingAvailability<'a>, TentativePublication, and InvocationObservation<'a> all derive serde::Serialize with sound lifetime bindings tied to the borrowed StagedProgram and ProducedInvocation. project_execution, project_segment, and project_stage_result use exhaustive struct/enum field destructuring over crate::Execution, crate::stage::StageSegment, crate::stage::StageOutcome, and crate::stage::StageRejection without dropping or synthesizing fields. serialize_staged_program serializes all four public StagedProgram components (program, plan, lowercase hex program_hash, lowercase hex plan_hash).

source_findings.subject: Per-segment diagnostic accounting and overflow handling
source_findings.detail: account_effects borrows the slice &[Effect] and groups only Effect::Transfer and Effect::Fee in first-encounter (asset, account) order while leaving Effect::State, Effect::Liability, and Effect::Emit untouched in the borrowed effects slice and snapshots. Fees are accumulated into fee_debit/fee_receipts and gross_debit/gross_receipts once (never double-counted), and reverse transfers add to receipts rather than subtracting from gross_debit. AmountAggregate::add uses u128::checked_add and saturates to AboveU128 on overflow, which sets NetFlow::Unavailable. Waiting { segment: None, .. } maps to (AccountingAvailability::NoPublishedSegment, TentativePublication::NoAdvancedSegment) without fabricating an empty execution, and Err(StageRejection) maps to (AccountingAvailability::RejectedNoPublishedDelta, TentativePublication::UnavailableFromStageRejection) while preserving error, attempted, and committed.

source_findings.subject: Shared CLI publication() preservation of legacy Core/2 keys and STAGE_LABELS
source_findings.detail: ProducedInvocation::publication(&self) constructs the exact legacy JSON object for Waiting (status, advanced, segment, continuation, attempted, committed: continuation.logical.committed, residual), Complete (status, segment, attempted, committed, residual), and Rejected (status, error, attempted, committed), inserts "financial_observation": serde_json::to_value(self.observation())?, and inserts all three crate::stage::STAGE_LABELS ("qualification": "local-reference-stage", "authentication": "none", "consumption": "untracked"). In simulate.rs, run_stage_start and run_resume call start_observed and resume_observed once stage::load and bounded input decoding succeed, then call print_produced_stage_result(&produced), which invokes produced.publication() and print_stage_report(report) and preserves ExitCode::SUCCESS on Ok and ExitCode::FAILURE on Err. Explicit Sherlock CLI selection (execution_profile, source_profile, entry, execution_config) still routes to sherlock::run(&args) without renaming or relabeling the pure Sherlock Core / draft HostOnly route.

source_findings.subject: Pre-producer load/decode failure path in CLI vs. in-producer StageRejection
source_findings.detail: In simulate.rs, when stage::load or bounded file read/decode fails in run_stage_start or run_resume before a StagedProgram and Scenario/Continuation/StageEvent exist, the Err(rejected) branch calls print_stage_result(Err(rejected)), emitting the legacy rejected JSON object without a "financial_observation" field (since no StagedProgram or decoded input exists to construct ProducedInvocation). Once stage::load and input decoding succeed, any stage admission or evaluation rejection inside start_observed or resume_observed is wrapped in ProducedInvocation and published via print_produced_stage_result with "financial_observation" (outcome: Rejected, accounting: RejectedNoPublishedDelta, tentative_publication: UnavailableFromStageRejection).

source_findings.subject: Positive integration test binding and assertions
source_findings.detail: The test loads retained-payment.mori via stage::load, deserializes scenario.json and INPUTS.json, executes projection::start_observed, feeds the actual returned Waiting continuation into projection::resume_observed with the false release event, and feeds the actual returned Waiting continuation from the false resume into projection::resume_observed with the true release event. At each of the three steps it verifies: (1) complete raw_result() JSON equality against START/FALSE/TRUE-RESULT.json, (2) std::ptr::eq(view.program, &program) and std::ptr::eq(view.result, produced.raw_result()), (3) full serialized InvocationObservation equality against frozen PROGRAM.json, PLAN.json, hashes, captured input, raw result, outcome, accounting, and tentative_publication, (4) full produced.publication() equality against the legacy stage report keys plus financial_observation and STAGE_LABELS, and (5) direct field equality on observation().input.
